# Sensor mode request sender

Sends the type-7 sensor mode request (exposure block and mode block).

**Category:** function · **Address:** `0x601fce30` (runtime cached) · <span class="pill pill-released">Camera-confirmed</span>
{ .facts }

**Build:** [E-M5 Mark III firmware 1.7, build 1700](../firmware/em5-iii-1700.md) · **Cameras:** [Olympus OM-D E-M5 Mark III](../cameras/em5-iii.md)

Live view is mode 9 at 120 fps, half press mode 0 at 60, shutter mode 14. It has 11 callers in section 1, so hooks here need a boot guard.

## Observations

- **Static analysis** ([Olympus firmware notes (E-M5 Mark III)](../projects/em5-iii-notes.md)): Request layout and callers read from the code. Source: [E-M5 III shooting sequencer](../sources/em5n.sequencer.md).
- **Physical camera** ([Olympus firmware notes (E-M5 Mark III)](../projects/em5-iii-notes.md)): Changing the request made burst frames follow the set shutter time (125 ms apart at 1/8 s). Source: [E-M5 III sensor](../sources/em5n.sensor.md).
